text: I can define linearizability (Herlihy and Wing) and show with a timeline how a follower read breaks a username uniqueness check.
I can explain how sequential consistency differs from linearizability using ZooKeeper's read behaviour.
I can explain causal order and show how dependency tracking prevents a post becoming visible before an earlier permission change.
I can state exactly what eventual consistency promises and construct a last-write-wins timeline that loses an acknowledged write.
I can implement read-your-writes and monotonic reads with version tracking or session pinning instead of leader-only reads.
I can choose the weakest safe model per operation and estimate its cost, such as DynamoDB read capacity for strong vs eventual reads.
